# teamcity_build_configuration_template (Resource)

Attaches an existing build configuration template to a build configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teamcity_project" "test" {
  name = "Test Project"
}

resource "teamcity_template" "test" {
  name       = "Test Template"
  project_id = teamcity_project.test.id
}

resource "teamcity_build_configuration" "test" {
  name       = "Test Build Conf"
  project_id = teamcity_project.test.id
}

resource "teamcity_build_configuration_template" "test" {
  build_configuration_id = teamcity_build_configuration.test.id
  template_id            = teamcity_template.test.id
}
```

## Import

```shell
terraform import teamcity_build_configuration_template.test build_configuration_id/template_id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_configuration_id` (String) ID of the build configuration the template is attached to.
- `template_id` (String) ID of the template to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the form 'build_configuration_id/template_id'.
